versionStatus.description: The measured security state of one Vaadin release: its state, how many advisories are open as a risk and in triage, the upgrade target of its line and when it was scanned. Refuses a version that was never measured and names the nearest one that was.

cveStatus.description: How one advisory stands, by its CVE or GHSA id: its severity, the team's verdict, and how each maintained line is covered, which release fixes it. With a version, how the advisory stands on that one release. Refuses an id the measurements do not know.

id.description: The advisory id, for example CVE-2026-89407

version.description: Optional. A Vaadin release to answer for, for example 24.9.21

upgradeTarget.description: What upgrading a Vaadin release to the newest release of its line clears and what remains open. Refuses a version that was never measured and names the nearest one that was.

openFindings.description: The advisories open on one Vaadin release, the risk list and the triage list, one line each with its severity and verdict, a page at a time. Refuses a version that was never measured and names the nearest one that was.

offset.description: Optional. Where the page starts, 0 by default; the result names the next offset when there is more

limit.description: Optional. How many lines the page holds, at most 25, 25 by default

queueHead.description: The top of the verdict queue: the packages whose verdict would close the most open advisories, in the queue's order.

refusals.versionMissing: Give the Vaadin release as the version argument, for example 24.9.21.
refusals.notMeasured: Version {0} was never measured. The nearest measured release is {1}; ask about that one, or tell the person so.
refusals.notMeasuredLine: Version {0} was never measured, and no release of its line {1} was. The measured lines are {2}.
refusals.idMissing: Give the advisory id as the id argument, for example CVE-2026-89407.
refusals.unknownAdvisory: The measurements know no advisory {0}. Check the id; a GHSA id is known only when the team tracks it under that id.
refusals.notOnVersion: Advisory {0} was not found on release {1}: the measurements of that release do not list it.
refusals.queueRange: n must be a whole number from 1 to 20, and {0} is not.
refusals.unreachable: The published measurements cannot be read right now. Tell the person that the data is unreachable, and nothing else.
refusals.gridFirstColumn: The grid narrows the advisories list, so the first column of the query must be advisories.cve. Write the query again with it first.
refusals.gridOnlySelect: Only a single SELECT query is accepted.
